bibliographic.title: In The Cubicle
bibliographic.author: Tom Fox
bibliographic.description:
After a long day of doing nothing, you sink gratefully into your bed. Sometime later, you roll off and drop to the ground with a dull thud. You wake up, and a shocking sight meets your eyes - this isn't your room!

What makes things worse is the fact that there are no visible exits... and you have claustrophobia...
